dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Next time someone wants to trade shifts with you, don't agree to it!

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yes, ma'am.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: You Eremites are too used to idling in the desert to know the importance of rules!

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: If everyone switched shifts at will and didn't follow schedule, it would turn into a big mess!

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yes, you are right.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Even though you're a mercenary hired by the Akademiya, your job of keeping law and order on the docks is as crucial as the researchers', got it?

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yes, I got it.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Say, if I wasn't such a bookworm, would I... *burp* be more popular in school?

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yeah, perhaps.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Say, if I was as *burp* agreeable as you, I probably would be on better terms with everybody...

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yeah, probably.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Say, if I was less blunt... *burp*, I might've been promoted by now...

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yeah, very likely.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Say, am I unworthy of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's legacy by being so mediocre?

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Yeah... Wait, no.

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Don't say that. You're doing a very important job right now.

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: R—Really...? *burp*
